decisions.reason: Because the construction site dumper was only briefly mentioned rather than strongly showcased, management has less public commitment and less need to justify continued support, making it the easiest 2019 launch to discontinue if results stayed unclear.

The inclined furniture lift had its own page and sits within the firm's lifting activities, so the visible launch and likely engineering effort create enough commitment for management to continue it while treating weak traction as temporary.

The inclined building material lift was publicly presented on its own page and fits closely with the firm's construction and lifting orientation, which under escalation-of-commitment logic makes management relatively likely to persist.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift appears to embody a more substantial product commitment and was visibly promoted, so management is likely to keep it on the market rather than admit a failed launch unless poor results become undeniable.
